entities.name: Swift-Arm
entities.description: A kitsune of the Hyozan Reckoners who runs the elite Golden-Tail Academy for Imperial samurai on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A Kamigawa group of which Swift-Arm is a member.

entities.name: Golden-Tail Academy
entities.description: An elite academy for Imperial samurai run by Swift-Arm.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker whose training Swift-Arm oversaw in the Imperial Palace.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: An Imperial figure who decided Kaito and Eiko should no longer spar and later ended Kaito's training with the Emperor.

entities.name: Eiko
entities.description: Kaito's sister and former sparring partner.

entities.name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: The ruler of Kamigawa, who became Kaito's sparring partner.

entities.name: Imperial Palace
entities.description: The palace on Kamigawa where Kaito trained.

events.summary: Swift-Arm was assigned to oversee Kaito's training after Light-Paws decided Kaito and Eiko should no longer be sparring partners.
events.quote: he was assigned to oversee Kaito's training after Light-Paws decided that Kaito and his sister, Eiko , should no longer be sparring partners

events.summary: Swift-Arm introduced Kaito to his new sparring partner, the Emperor of Kamigawa.
events.quote: Swift-Arm introduced Kaito to his new sparring partner, who turned out to be the Emperor of Kamigawa herself.

events.summary: Light-Paws informed Kaito he would no longer train with the Emperor, ending Swift-Arm's involvement as Kaito rejected the role of samurai.
events.quote: Light-Paws informed Kaito that he would no longer train with the Emperor

relations.quote: Swift-Arm is a kitsune member of the Hyozan Reckoners from Kamigawa .
Swift-Arm is a kitsune who runs the elite Golden-Tail Academy for Imperial samurai .

relations.note: He oversaw Kaito's training; the role later diminished.
relations.quote: he was assigned to oversee Kaito's training
